Under the Hood — What a Skill Actually Is
Every skill is a simple folder containing one plain-text file called SKILL.md. That file has two parts:
description: Write LinkedIn posts for AI Onboarded
Everything Claude needs: your voice, format, rules, output style
Claude reads the short description at the top and automatically decides when to activate the skill — either when you type /skill-name or when your request matches the trigger phrases.
there a task where I find myself giving Claude the same instructions
? That task should be a Skill.
Built-in Skills are developed and optimized by Anthropic. They are pre-installed — you don't configure them. They activate automatically when you work with specific file types.

Claude will ask you questions. These are the answers to give — say them out loud so the class hears your thinking:
— weekly AI news podcast. Co-hosted by Rajesh and Sanjay Rajput. Audience is non-
Conversational and warm — two friends catching up. Occasional humor. Never technical or dry. No jargon without plain English explanation.
Where does the news come from?
First check working folder for any AI news digest file. If nothing
, search web for top AI stories from last 7 days. Prioritize OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Microsoft. Always one wildcard story.
Cold open → Intro banter → Story 1 (biggest) → Story 2 → Story 3 (wildcard) → The Human Angle → Weekly Insight → Outro

reacts with question or comment, then 4-6 natural back-and-forth exchanges.
